text.description_html:
Fusion PH-F3, Wall Mounted Tai Chi Toilet Tissue Holder

The Tai Chi Toiler Paper Holder is easy to install and mounts directly to the wall with the included installation hardware kit. The bamboo detailing on the mount makes it a great addition to Asian or island themed homes. This toilet tissue holder has a medium bronze finish.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TR-F3 Tai Chi Towel Ring, Fusion TB-F3 Tai Chi Towel Bar, and Fusion RH-F3 Tai Chi Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Tai Chi Collection Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Finish: Medium Bronze
  • Mount Diameter: 2-3/4"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
